_meta.law: #587 S213 image-size policy (JPEG-by-default for photographic/noisy evidence) + tools/evidence_image_optimizer.py + tools/policy_validator.py
rules: exceptions are EXACT-PATH, narrowly scoped, owned, and expiring; no directory-wide or extension-wide blanket exception is valid

each entry must record: path, owner, evidence/claim ID, reason class (alpha|diagram|pixel-art|pixel-exact|animation|other-justified), source sha256, measured JPEG alternative (size/quality) when applicable, review/expiry trigger
legacy over-threshold assets present at S213 adoption are recorded in docs/IMAGE_POLICY_BASELINE.json (per-path legacy inventory), NOT here; new files must pass the policy or hold an entry here
a new over-threshold image without a matching entry here or in the baseline fails the policy validator
animated assets are never flattened to stills; their exception reason must be animation-preservation
_meta.expiry: per-entry review_trigger; unconditional review at the incremental migration wave tracked in #386
